# PreferencesPanel

Per-device display preferences, applied live as you choose: theme (System, Dark, Light, Booth), text size, row density and reduce motion.

`SongNodes.PreferencesPanel` · Navigation

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.PreferencesPanel value={…} onChange={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.PreferencesPanel" value="{{…}}" on-change="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

## Props (PreferencesPanelProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` * | `{ theme; textSize: "s" \| "m" \| "l" \| "xl"; density: "comfortable" \| "compact"; motion: "system" \| "red…` | Current preferences, from SongNodes.prefs.get() plus motion. |
| `onChange` * | `(next: PreferencesPanelProps["value"]) => void` | Called on every change; apply immediately via SongNodes.prefs. |
| `onClose` | `() => void` | Called by the close button. |
